data.name: Crop Meister
data.detailed_description:
Start with a small field and grow into a true master of agriculture, a farming simulator focused on crop growth, leveling, and satisfying progression.

Plant seeds, care for your fields, and guide your crops through multiple stages of growth. Each plant has its own growth time, value, and experience reward. As you harvest and sell your produce, you gain XP to level up your farming mastery, unlocking new crop types, better tools, and powerful upgrades.

Instead of running a shop, you’ll sell your harvest directly to a merchant cart that arrives to collect your goods. Choose what to sell and when, and optimize your fields for the most profitable and efficient harvests.

As you progress, expand your farmland, improve your equipment, and refine your growing strategy. Whether you prefer slow, relaxing farming or efficient, optimized crop production, Crop Meister delivers a rewarding loop of:

Plant → Grow → Harvest → Sell → Level Up

Key Features:

- Crop-Focused Gameplay
Grow a wide variety of crops with unique growth cycles, values, and experience rewards.

- Leveling & Progression System
Earn XP from farming and selling. Unlock new seeds, tools, and upgrades as you level up.

- Sell to the Merchant Cart
Load harvested crops onto a traveling cart to convert your yield into profit — no store management, just pure farming.

- Growth & Planning Mechanics
Different crops thrive under different conditions, encouraging smart planning and land use.

- Upgrades & Expansion
Improve tools, unlock new farming areas, and increase crop yield and growth speed over time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.4 Ghz Dual Core CPU
  • Graphics: 2 GB Dedicated Memory
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
